sonnet.problem: The question says every Midianite male is dead, which rules out both wrong answers. The kings' servants and guards and the priests and elders are all males, so the setup leaves only the women and children as the answer.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: The summary card for the division of the spoils goes item by item. It lists 675,000 sheep, 72,000 cattle, 61,000 donkeys and 32,000 women, then walks through the halves and the tributes. It is also long and carries many details.
sonnet.rule: He says in a few words what it covers and doesn't go item by item.

sonnet.problem: The summary card for the purification rules lists the items one by one (garment, leather good, goat's hair item, wooden article) and explains the fire and water procedure in detail, instead of saying in a few words what the stretch covers.
sonnet.rule: He says in a few words what it covers and doesn't go item by item.
